qualification.education_qualification: MBBS or BDS or Equivalent, Post Graduate in Biostatistics, Statistics, Data Science, Health Informatics or related discipline
qualification.details: Senior Consultant (Medical): Professional having proven competency and success in the area of Public Health/Pediatrics/Child Health/Maternal and Newborn Health, with at least 12 years of post-qualification experience and should possess minimum MBBS or BDS or Equivalent degree. OR Retired Government employee with requisite qualification and who were in regular Pay level 10 and above and having at least 10 years of experience in the required Public Health/Pediatrics/Child Health/Maternal and Newborn Health. (PhD=4 years exp, MD/MS=3 years exp) Young Professional II: Post Graduates in Biostatistics, Statistics, Data Science, Health Informatics, or a related discipline from a recognized institution, with at least 55% marks and 3 years of post qualification experience in the field of Biomedical Research/Public Health/Implementation Research/working in a renowned statistical organization. (PhD=4 years exp)

content_sections.heading: ICMR Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the ICMR Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download ICMR Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ICMR Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Senior Consultant (Medical) and 1 for Young Professional II.

content_sections.heading: ICMR Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Consultant (Medical): Professional having proven competency and success in the area of Public Health/Pediatrics/Child Health/Maternal and Newborn Health, with at least 12 years of post-qualification experience and should possess minimum MBBS or BDS or Equivalent degree. OR Retired Government employee with requisite qualification and who were in regular Pay level 10 and above and having at least 10 years of experience in the required Public Health/Pediatrics/Child Health/Maternal and Newborn Health. (PhD=4 years exp, MD/MS=3 years exp) Young Professional II: Post Graduates in Biostatistics, Statistics, Data Science, Health Informatics, or a related discipline from a recognized institution, with at least 55% marks and 3 years of post qualification experience in the field of Biomedical Research/Public Health/Implementation Research/working in a renowned statistical organization. (PhD=4 years exp)

content_sections.heading: ICMR Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 40 years Maximum Age: 70 years Age relaxation will be as per discretion of the competent authority of the Council. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: ICMR Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Senior Consultant (Medical): Rs.1,50,000/- PM Young Professional II: Rs. 42,000/- PM

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the ICMR Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of ICMR to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICMR recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the ICMR recruitment is 27 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this ICMR recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by the Indian Council of Medical Research for the posts of Senior Consultant (Medical) and Young Professional - II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Consultant (Medical) post?
faq.answer: For the Senior Consultant (Medical) post, candidates need an MBBS or BDS or Equivalent degree with at least 12 years of post-qualification experience, or retired government employees with specific experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ICMR recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for the ICMR recruitment is between a minimum of 40 years and a maximum of 70 years. Age relaxation may be provided as per the council's discretion.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional - II position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Young Professional - II position is Rs. 42,000/- per month. This is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ICMR recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this ICMR recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these ICMR posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the ICMR recruitment involves an Interview and a Personal Discussion. Candidates will be shortlisted based on these stages.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these ICMR positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions at ICMR is contractual. Candidates will be appointed on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for ICMR recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for ICMR recruitment can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q10. How should I apply for the ICMR recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for ICMR recruitment must be submitted online through the official ICMR website or the provided 'Apply Online' link before the last date.
